errata.orig:
In section 1. Introduction it says:
Example of a SIP REGISTER request in the flow above:

REGISTER sip:alice@example.com SIP/2.0
(the rest part of the message is omitted)

In section 4.1.4.  Sending Binding-Refresh Requests Using Non-push Mechanism it says:

Example of a SIP REGISTER request including a 'sip.pnsreg' media feature tag:

REGISTER sip:alice@example.com SIP/2.0
(the rest part of the message is omitted)
errata.correct:
In section 1. Introduction it should be:
Example of a SIP REGISTER request in the flow above:

REGISTER sip:example.com SIP/2.0
(the rest part of the message is omitted)

In section 4.1.4.  Sending Binding-Refresh Requests Using Non-push Mechanism it should be:

Example of a SIP REGISTER request including a 'sip.pnsreg' media feature tag:

REGISTER sip:example.com SIP/2.0
(the rest part of the message is omitted)
errata.notes:
The error is in R-URI:
REGISTER sip:alice@example.com SIP/2.0
It should be:
REGISTER sip:example.com SIP/2.0

According to RFC3261 - 10.2 Constructing the REGISTER Request -  Request-URI: The Request-URI names the domain of the location service for which the registration is meant (for example, "sip:chicago.com").  The "userinfo" and "@" components of the SIP URI MUST NOT be present.

errata.orig:
Example of a SIP REGISTER response including a 'sip.pnsreg'
     media feature tag and a 'sip.pnsreq' feature-capability indicator:

If the UA receives a 2xx response to the REGISTER request that
   contains a Feature-Caps header field with a 'sip.pnsreq' feature-
   capability indicator,

If the UA receives a 2xx response to the REGISTER request that does
   not contain a Feature-Caps header field with a 'sip.pnsreq' feature-
   capability indicator,
errata.correct:
Example of a SIP REGISTER response including a 'sip.pnsreg'
     media feature tag and a 'sip.pnsreg' feature-capability indicator:

If the UA receives a 2xx response to the REGISTER request that
   contains a Feature-Caps header field with a 'sip.pnsreg' feature-
   capability indicator,

If the UA receives a 2xx response to the REGISTER request that does
   not contain a Feature-Caps header field with a 'sip.pnsreg' feature-
   capability indicator,
errata.notes: “sip.pnsreq” should be “sip.pnsreg” in the three sentences in this report.
